ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-23-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Joseph M. Quinn, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Petitioner Dieu Thi Nguyen mother of minor present in court.
Father of minor Timmy Vuu present in court to object to the name change of minor.
Petitioner Dieu Thi Nguyen sworn and examined on her own behalf. Objecting parent Timmy Vuu sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name of mother Dieu Thi Nguyen.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of Dieu Thi Nguyen to Elli Nguyen.
After the court examined father/objecting party. Parents agreed to change the name of minor Sienna Song Vuu to Ella Nguyen Vuu. The court agreed to grant the name change as modified.
Court in open court made modification to Decree for Name Change.

Decree Changing Names signed in open court.
